title: StandardTestInput
description: Formal 5-field contract between ADLC/Memory and Test Design Agent

function_id.description: Unique identifier tracing back to the feature requirement (e.g., FUNC-USER-ADD)

feature.description: Human-readable name of the feature to test (e.g., Add User)

precondition.description: Prerequisite state or environment conditions required before execution

expected_result.description: Expected outcomes or assertions defining success

business_rules.description: Optional domain business rules associated with this function

validation_rules.description: Optional form or field validation constraints
